description: This file implements the 'upgrade' command as part of a development tool for managing recipes in a build system (likely Yocto/OE). It contains functions for extracting source code, creating new recipes, handling version upgrades, and updating license information. The code interacts with source control (git), fetch utilities, and recipe management utils, indicating it's a plugin or module for automating recipe upgrades within a build environment.

methods.name: _run(cmd, cwd='')
methods.description: Executes the given command in the specified current working directory, with debug-level logging.

methods.name: _get_srctree(tmpdir)
methods.description: Determines the source tree directory from a temporary directory, trimming to a subdirectory if only one exists.

methods.name: _copy_source_code(orig, dest)
methods.description: Copies source code files from origin to destination directory, preserving structure.

methods.name: _remove_patch_dirs(recipefolder)
methods.description: Removes all patch directories within a recipe folder.

methods.name: _recipe_contains(rd, var)
methods.description: Checks whether a specific variable (e.g., PV) is present in the recipe files.

methods.name: _rename_recipe_dirs(oldpv, newpv, path)
methods.description: Renames directories and .inc files containing a specific old version string to a new version string.

methods.name: _rename_recipe_file(oldrecipe, bpn, oldpv, newpv, path)
methods.description: Renames an individual recipe file if it matches the old version pattern to the new version.

methods.name: _rename_recipe_files(oldrecipe, bpn, oldpv, newpv, path)
methods.description: Performs renaming of recipe directories and recipe file based on version change.

methods.name: _write_append(rc, srctree, same_dir, no_same_dir, rev, copied, workspace, d)
methods.description: Creates or updates a .bbappend file with external source configuration, reflecting source path and revision info.

methods.name: _cleanup_on_error(rd, srctree)
methods.description: Removes temporary or source directories in case of errors during upgrade process.

methods.name: _upgrade_error(e, rd, srctree, keep_failure=False, extramsg=None)
methods.description: Handles errors during upgrade, cleans up, logs, and exits.

methods.name: _get_uri(rd)
methods.description: Extracts the source URI and revision from a recipe's SRC_URI variable.

methods.name: _extract_new_source(newpv, srctree, no_patch, srcrev, srcbranch, branch, keep_temp, tinfoil, rd)
methods.description: Downloads or fetches new source code for a recipe at a specified version, handling git or URL sources, and prepares the source tree.

methods.name: _add_license_diff_to_recipe(path, diff)
methods.description: Appends license checksum differences to the recipe file.

methods.name: _create_new_recipe(newpv, md5, sha256, srcrev, srcbranch, srcsubdir_old, srcsubdir_new, workspace, tinfoil, rd, license_diff, new_licenses, srctree, keep_failure)
methods.description: Builds a new recipe file with updated version, source info, licenses, and patches.

methods.name: _check_git_config()
methods.description: Verifies user.git configuration for name and email necessary for rebasing.

methods.name: _extract_licenses(srcpath, recipe_licenses)
methods.description: Reads license files from source directory and computes their checksums and contents.

methods.name: _generate_license_diff(old_licenses, new_licenses)
methods.description: Creates a diff between old and new license texts if they differ.

methods.name: upgrade(args, config, basepath, workspace)
methods.description: Main function to perform recipe and source upgrade process, handling argument parsing, source extraction, recipe creation, and license updates.

methods.name: latest_version(args, config, basepath, workspace)
methods.description: Queries upstream for the latest available version of a recipe.

methods.name: check_upgrade_status(args, config, basepath, workspace)
methods.description: Checks and reports whether recipes are up to date with upstream versions.

methods.name: register_commands(subparsers, context)
methods.description: Registers CLI subcommands related to upgrade and version checking for this plugin.
